label: copy phase: fed-back c with 2 next to output (c->2 bigram), late in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (94% of mass) when the fed-back input is c (a repeat of an original c), and only from recall_idx >= 3 on. Magnitude depends on the token being output next: strongest when it is 2, i.e. the original had the bigram c 2 (precision 0.80, 58% of mass on dev). Weaker when the output is 3, t or c (adding those raises mass recall to 0.88 but precision drops to 0.38). A small amount of mass is on input 2 right after a c. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and never on c inputs early in the copy (recall_idx < 3). Most copy-phase c inputs followed by other tokens stay inactive, so precision for plain copy-phase c is only 0.04.

Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=c (+6.88), in_tok=c (+4.42), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+3.91), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+3.91), out_tok=2 (+3.78), next_out=2 (+3.67).
